title: If You Know These 5 Words, Your English Is Advanced (Part 1) #shorts
description:
If you know these 5 words, your English is advanced:
• Meticulous: very careful about every detail
• Resilient: able to recover quickly
• Pragmatic: practical and realistic
• Ubiquitous: found everywhere
• Eloquent: speaking clearly and well

How many did you know? Write your score in the comments.
